name_en: Variational equation for ODE solution sensitivity
canonical_name: ODE variational or sensitivity equation family
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no equation, state or parameter spaces, solution model, differentiability hypotheses, common domain, base trajectory, sensitivity variable, homogeneous or inhomogeneous form, operator orientation, initial tangent condition, or logical strength. An inspected authoritative source distinguishes initial-state and external-parameter equations. Selecting one at intake would invent missing mathematics and may duplicate THM-M-1340.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix time, state and parameter spaces and universes, topology and normed structure, vector field and domain, solution carrier, and continuous-linear-map conventions.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose differentiability of a solution map, a homogeneous initial-state variational equation, an inhomogeneous parameter sensitivity equation, or existence/uniqueness and identification of its solution.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: the initial-state derivative of a local flow satisfies a homogeneous linear ODE with identity initial condition
a directional initial-state sensitivity satisfies the same homogeneous linear ODE with the chosen tangent as initial value
the derivative with respect to an external parameter satisfies an inhomogeneous linear ODE with a forcing term from the parameter derivative of the field
a parameter-dependent initial condition adds its own derivative to the sensitivity initial condition
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1339 continuous dependence used as differentiable sensitivity
THM-M-1340 parameter differentiability duplicated without a reviewed equation-consequence boundary
Picard-Lindelof existence or ODE uniqueness alone
a generic Frechet chain rule or continuous-linear-map identity alone
an autonomous, scalar, equilibrium-only, global, or one-dimensional special case absent source selection
a hypothesis or bundled structure that already assumes the desired sensitivity equation
the catalog's untrusted verified label or the API probe as proof credit
